_comment: Carry destination for the next #3885 group: the CI-cost levers the light-grading
pull request (handoff/ci-3885-nonprod-scope) measured and left open. Shape and
stage: the next #3885 group: CI cost of grading a head twice, after light grading

carries.from: the #3885 light-grading pull request (handoff/ci-3885-nonprod-scope): its `## Figures` measured duplicate verified dispatches with dev/audit/harnesses/ci3885_light.py (at 7eb9b2fd81bbe71be048e730481470de62c0932c) dup
carries.control: Established by measurement with its null control. `python3 dev/audit/harnesses/ci3885_light.py (at 7eb9b2fd81bbe71be048e730481470de62c0932c) dup 2026-11-21` counted 28 of 38 PR-naming ci.yml workflow_dispatch runs (17,495 runner-min) created after a pull_request run at the same head had completed with a conclusion other than cancelled, action_required or skipped; the other 10 (5,666 runner-min) were their head's sole grader. Null control: the same arm on 2026-11-24 counts 0 of 0, and on 2026-11-23 2 of 6 (304 runner-min), so the arm does not read every dispatch as a duplicate. Unit sets were not compared: 17,495 is an upper bound on what reuse saves, against 5,189 runner-min the light stand-downs saved on that day's dispatches.
carries.remeasure: Do not trust the counts: they are 2026-11-21's, and that day predates CI-2 (verified dispatch scoped by the three-dot list, 2eea9dc559). Re-run `python3 dev/audit/harnesses/ci3885_light.py (at 7eb9b2fd81bbe71be048e730481470de62c0932c) dup DAY` for a busy day after your merge base, and compare each duplicate's unit set (tools/ci/prelude.py outputs) against its earlier pull_request run's before counting it.
carries.brief: First find why a verified dispatch was fired at a head a pull_request run had already graded (the dispatcher's own trigger, read from tools/audit/seat/ and tools/pr/), because stopping the redundant dispatch at its source may need no CI change at all. Only if the dispatch is needed, make a dispatch whose head carries a concluded pull_request run with the same unit set reuse that run's verdict: tools/ci/gate.py would then accept another run's job conclusions as this run's required contexts, which is a trust-model change and needs a design (decision 0014) before a fixer. Carry: #3885

carries.from: the #3885 light-grading pull request (handoff/ci-3885-nonprod-scope): its `## Forward-carry`, on the env_drift cache after a light push
carries.control: Not measured: stated from the mechanism, with the measurement owed. A light push is graded GATE_SCOPE=auto over its range (tools/ci/prelude.py push_range), so tests/env_drift.py runs only when the range reaches its closure in tests/closures.json; env_drift's cache key includes baseline_commit, so a light push that does not run it saves no entry at its commit. The perturbation that would show it: two consecutive light pushes on main where the second's range reaches env_drift; its `fast` log should read a cache miss where a full push before it would have left a hit.
carries.remeasure: Read the `fast` job logs of the first push run on main after this pull request merges whose range reaches tests/env_drift.py, and the one before it, and record hit or miss for the env_drift cache in each, with their run ids.
carries.brief: Measure whether a light push leaves tests/env_drift.py's cache cold for the next run that runs it, and what that costs in runner-minutes per occurrence; if it costs more than carrying the previous entry forward, carry it forward the way tests.yml's coverage job carries its range base's per-script entry on a stood-down push. Carry: #3885
